info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Discount Pricing Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage discount pricing strategies for their products. This endpoint facilitates the adjustment of pricing parameters based on specific identifiers, ensuring pricing remains competitive and aligned with market demands. Typical consumers of this API include product management teams and pricing analysts who use it to optimize pricing structures. By enabling targeted updates to discount pricing, organizations can enhance profitability and meet customer expectations effectively.

patch.summary: Update discount pricing for a specific resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the discount pricing associated with a particular resource identified by RES-100045. Use this endpoint to modify the pricing details effectively, ensuring the updated information reflects the current pricing strategy of the product management system.

requestBody.description: Contains the details necessary to update the discount pricing for the specified product. Ensure that all required fields are included to process the request successfully.

200.description: Successful update of the discount pricing resource.
